title: Term Life Insurance Face Decrease Limits
content:
On every Term Life Insurance tier — the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term and the Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 — a face decrease may first take effect in policy year 2, and no more than 1 face decrease may take effect in one policy year.

| Limit | All tiers |
|---|---|
| Earliest policy year in which a decrease may take effect | 2 |
| Decreases that may take effect in one policy year | 1 |

Illustration (hypothetical): a decrease that would take effect in policy year 1 is outside the limit; one taking effect in policy year 2 is inside it; a second decrease taking effect in the same policy year as an earlier completed one exceeds the count of 1.
